Title: General Availability: Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server networking with Azure Private Link

Body.Content:
Many users of Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server require secure private network access to provide flexibility, easy connectivity to other Azure services, high security, and isolation.  
 
With the general availability of Azure Private Link based networking, you can create private endpoints for Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server bringing it inside your virtual network. With Private Link, traffic between your virtual network and the service travels the Microsoft backbone network. Exposing your service to the public internet is no longer necessary. You can create your own private link service in your virtual network. This feature is available in all public Azure regions where service is currently available and adds to existing networking capabilities provided by VNET injection. 

Learn more.
